description:
Use this when the user wants a photo or picture brought into RipClip to edit it: "brighten this photo",
        "edit my picture", "fix the colors on this image". url: a direct https link to a .jpg, .png or .webp picture,
        or a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link open to anyone with the link. file: a picture the user
        attached, where the assistant passes attached files to tools. Up to 24 MB; kept at its own size. Returns
        job_id; poll job_status, whose clip_ids then holds the photo's id for adjust_look, frame_clip, style_clip,
        add_to_clip, preview_frame and get_download_link (the edited picture).
        Not for: videos (import_video), photos already in RipClip (list_clips kind photo), or changing what is in the
        picture, such as removing a person (not done by RipClip). Free.

PhotoFile.description: a file the user attached in ChatGPT (Apps SDK openai/fileParams: download_url and file_id always come)
